additional_info.subject: ID0478972-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / S3 170003440] Password Configuration & Recurrent Fault on Left Charger CRM:03380000136
additional_info.body:
Hi colleagues,
Afonso asked me to support you on this subject.
First, the authentication that you are requesting is not possible. If the customer doesn't want a OCPP backend, then there is no authentication possible.
Second, the problem that the customer is reporting was DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 which is no longer present from the past 1 week. It seems like there is some loose wiring in my opinion, because I can no longer access the data from the past to confirm if there is a defect.
Third, the LOGO software is wrong and we need to change it.
For the last 1 week, there was no charging session in the outlet that was not working, as such, I would recommend asking the customer to do a session in DC1 before we go there.
If the session works, there is no need to go to site. If the session fails, then we need to do one thing which is update the LOGO to the right version.
I send in attachment the firmware and the steps to update it.
ONLY PERFORM THESE STEPS IF YOU SEE AGAIN DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
:
measure these points:
The first ones, from top to bottom are directly on the cable and this is the color scheme:
If you have a sensor that doesn't read ~1kOhm, then the cable is faulty and needs replacement.
If the 1kOhm is measured then we need to measure it until the KF14 PT1 and PT2.
If you don't measure 1kOhm then that means either a cable is loose or broken.
If you measure 1kOhm on these inputs and still doesn't work:
Replace the grey connector where the cables are inserted, the other EcoG components have spare grey connectors that are not used at all.
If it still fails, try to replace KF14.

ID0478972-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / S3 170003440] Password Configuration & Recurrent Fault on Left Charger CRM:03380000136
Hi colleagues,
Afonso asked me to support you on this subject.
First, the authentication that you are requesting is not possible. If the customer doesn't want a OCPP backend, then there is no authentication possible.
Second, the problem that the customer is reporting was DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 which is no longer present from the past 1 week. It seems like there is some loose wiring in my opinion, because I can no longer access the data from the past to confirm if there is a defect.
Third, the LOGO software is wrong and we need to change it.
For the last 1 week, there was no charging session in the outlet that was not working, as such, I would recommend asking the customer to do a session in DC1 before we go there.
If the session works, there is no need to go to site. If the session fails, then we need to do one thing which is update the LOGO to the right version.
I send in attachment the firmware and the steps to update it.
ONLY PERFORM THESE STEPS IF YOU SEE AGAIN DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
:
measure these points:
The first ones, from top to bottom are directly on the cable and this is the color scheme:
If you have a sensor that doesn't read ~1kOhm, then the cable is faulty and needs replacement.
If the 1kOhm is measured then we need to measure it until the KF14 PT1 and PT2.
If you don't measure 1kOhm then that means either a cable is loose or broken.
If you measure 1kOhm on these inputs and still doesn't work:
Replace the grey connector where the cables are inserted, the other EcoG components have spare grey connectors that are not used at all.
If it still fails, try to replace KF14.

Hi colleagues,
Afonso asked me to support you on this subject.
First, the authentication that you are requesting is not possible. If the customer doesn't want a OCPP backend, then there is no authentication possible.
Second, the problem that the customer is reporting was DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 which is no longer present from the past 1 week. It seems like there is some loose wiring in my opinion, because I can no longer access the data from the past to confirm if there is a defect.
Third, the LOGO software is wrong and we need to change it.
For the last 1 week, there was no charging session in the outlet that was not working, as such, I would recommend asking the customer to do a session in DC1 before we go there.
If the session works, there is no need to go to site. If the session fails, then we need to do one thing which is update the LOGO to the right version.
I send in attachment the firmware and the steps to update it.
ONLY PERFORM THESE STEPS IF YOU SEE AGAIN DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
:
measure these points:
The first ones, from top to bottom are directly on the cable and this is the color scheme:
If you have a sensor that doesn't read ~1kOhm, then the cable is faulty and needs replacement.
If the 1kOhm is measured then we need to measure it until the KF14 PT1 and PT2.
If you don't measure 1kOhm then that means either a cable is loose or broken.
If you measure 1kOhm on these inputs and still doesn't work:
Replace the grey connector where the cables are inserted, the other EcoG components have spare grey connectors that are not used at all.
If it still fails, try to replace KF14.
